meta.name: requesting-code-review
meta.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在合并前自动检查代码是否满足需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在合并代码前确保工作符合要求
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify code meets requirements before merging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your code meets requirements before merging

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你完成代码任务后，自动派一个代码审查助手来检查你的代码，找出问题并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你完成一个子任务、实现主要功能，或准备合并代码到主分支时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查刚完成的代码修改。
say.note: Claude 会派审查助手检查当前代码变更。

say.text: 在合并前，请先做一次代码审查。
say.note: 确保代码质量后再合并。

say.text: 我卡住了，能帮我审查一下代码吗？
say.note: 审查助手可能提供新思路。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will dispatch a code reviewer subagent to examine your code changes, identify issues, and provide improvement suggestions after you complete a task.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you finish a subtask, implement a major feature, or before merging code to the main branch.

say_en.text: Please review the code changes I just made.
say_en.note: Claude will dispatch a reviewer to check the current diff.

say_en.text: Before merging, please do a code review first.
I'm stuck, can you review my code?
say_en.note: The reviewer may offer a fresh perspective.
